name: action
description:
Invokes a named accessibility action on an element, such as AXPress, AXShowMenu, or AXIncrement.
Use with element IDs from `see` or `inspect_ui` when a semantic action is available.
Background-only policy refuses actions that can raise or expose foreground UI, including AXPress and
AXShowMenu; use a dedicated background semantic tool or a human-authorized foreground-capable session.
Peekaboo MCP 4.9.9 using openai/gpt-5.6, anthropic/claude-opus-5

action.description: Accessibility action name to invoke, e.g. AXPress, AXShowMenu, AXIncrement, or the title of a UIKit/Catalyst custom action the element advertises (custom actions need foreground authorization).

on.description: Opaque element ID from current `see` or `inspect_ui` output, or a query string.

snapshot.description: Optional snapshot ID from `see` or `inspect_ui`; latest is used when omitted.

name: app
description:
Control applications under immutable background-only authority. Available actions are `list`, `quit`,
`hide`, and `launch`; background `launch` is only an exact already-running readiness probe and never cold
starts an app. Focus, switch, open, relaunch, unhide, new-instance, and `foreground=true` are unavailable
here because they can activate shared desktop UI. A human must start a foreground-capable Agent session or
use the standalone CLI with explicit foreground consent for those operations.

Process-generation chaining must use `target_identity.process_start_identity_decimal`; the numeric
`process_start_identity` field remains compatibility-only and can lose precision above 2^53.

Always include the `action` field in your JSON payload. Examples:
- { "action": "list" }
- Already-running readiness probe: { "action": "launch", "name": "Finder" }
- { "action": "quit", "name": "Slack", "force": false }

action.description: Background-only action; foreground lifecycle, focus, and switch actions are unavailable

except.description: Comma-separated list of apps to exclude when quitting all

waitForWindow.description: Wait until the launched app exposes an exact WindowServer window

waitUntilReady.description: Wait until LaunchServices reports startup complete

name: scroll
description:
Scrolls a fresh UI target in the background without interrupting the user. Peekaboo prefers
Accessibility, then may use exact-window PID-routed wheel events for an opaque visible WebKit target.
Set foreground=true to focus the target and allow global wheel events at the pointer.
Peekaboo MCP 4.9.9 using openai/gpt-5.6
and anthropic/claude-opus-5

amount.description: Optional. Number of scroll ticks/lines. Default: 3.

coordinate_reference.description: Capture-owned reference from see; must match snapshot when both are supplied.

coordinate_space.description: Coordinate basis, matching click. Image/normalized points need coordinate_reference.

coords.description: Background point x,y; global display points by default. Mutually exclusive with on.

delay.description: Optional. Foreground-only delay between scroll ticks in milliseconds. Default: 0.

direction.description: Scroll direction: up (content moves up), down (content moves down), left, or right.

foreground.description: Optional. Focus the target and allow global wheel events. Default: false.

on.description: Element ID from see or inspect_ui; mutually exclusive with coords.

smooth.description: Optional. Use smooth synthetic scrolling; requires foreground=true.

snapshot.description: Snapshot ID from see or inspect_ui. Element scroll defaults to latest; coords requires an explicit pixel-backed snapshot or coordinate_reference.

name: image
description:
Screenshot only; use see for element detection.
Captures macOS screen content without building an element map or running AI analysis.
Targets include entire displays, the frontmost window, app-specific windows (`app_target`),
or the menu bar. Capture is background-only by default. Set `capture_focus` to `foreground`
for visible capture feedback and exact app/PID activation before an app-targeted capture.
Output can be written to disk or returned inline as Base64 data (`format: "data"`).
Window shadows/frames are excluded automatically.

capture_focus.description: Optional. background (default), foreground (activate target), or legacy auto.

max_dimension.description:
Optional. Downscales the captured image so its longest side does not exceed this value.
Defaults to 1500 when format is "data".

path.description: Optional. Base absolute path for saving the image.

scale.description: Optional. Capture scale: logical|1x or native|retina|2x.

window_id.description: Optional. Exact WindowServer window ID; may be combined with an app target.

name: press
description:
Presses one or more raw keyboard chords. Use `keys` for a Peekaboo chord sequence such as
["cmd+c", "Return"], or use `key` plus `modifiers` for a single chord. The two input shapes are
mutually exclusive. Background-only MCP/Agent delivery requires an explicit fresh exact non-dialog snapshot receipt.
App, PID, window-selector-only, targetless, competing-selector, and foreground forms are refused.
Use case-insensitive macOS key names joined with '+' (cmd+shift+t). delete (also Delete, backspace or del) erases backward; forwarddelete/forward_delete erase forward. Use cmd/command for Command, not super.
Raw chords cannot prove semantic intent or effect; observe the exact target after unverified delivery.
Peekaboo MCP 4.9.9 using openai/gpt-5.6, anthropic/claude-opus-5

count.description: Optional repeat count for the complete chord sequence. Default: 1.

delay.description: Optional delay between chord presses in milliseconds. Default: 100.

hold.description: Hold duration for synthesized chords in milliseconds (default: 50). Semantic AX/menu actions do not hold keys.

key.description: Optional single primary key, used with modifiers instead of keys.

keys.description: Optional chord sequence, e.g. ['cmd+c', 'Return']. Use case-insensitive macOS key names joined with '+' (cmd+shift+t). delete (also Delete, backspace or del) erases backward; forwarddelete/forward_delete erase forward. Use cmd/command for Command, not super.

modifiers.description: Optional modifiers for the single key form.

snapshot.description: Required fresh exact non-dialog snapshot for receipt-pinned background press.

name: click
description:
Clicks on UI elements or coordinates.
Supports element queries, specific IDs from `see` or `inspect_ui`, or raw coordinates.
Choose exactly one of on, query, or coords, and at most one of double, triple, right, or middle.
Background delivery is the default. Background coordinates require a nonempty snapshot or coordinate_reference
from a fresh exact-window `see`; pid alone is never a safe coordinate target. Set `foreground` to true only for
intentional shared-pointer input, which may omit the capture reference.
Peekaboo MCP 4.9.9 using openai/gpt-5.6, anthropic/claude-opus-5

background.description: Deprecated inverse alias. false explicitly selects foreground shared-pointer delivery.

coordinate_reference.description:
Nonempty snapshot reference_id returned by a fresh exact-window see. Provide this or snapshot for
every background coordinate click; required for image_pixels and normalized coords.

coordinate_space.description: Optional. Coordinate basis for coords. image_pixels and normalized require coordinate_reference.

coords.description:
Coordinates in 'x,y' format, exclusive with on and query. Background delivery requires a nonempty
snapshot or coordinate_reference from a fresh exact-window see. Without a reference, set
foreground=true for intentional shared-pointer global logical points.

double.description: Optional. Double-click instead of single click.

foreground.description: Use foreground/shared-pointer delivery. Background delivery is the default.

middle.description: Optional. Middle-click with the center mouse button.

modifiers.description: Foreground-only modifier keys. Requires foreground=true and a fresh exact snapshot.

on.description:
Opaque element ID copied exactly from current `see` or `inspect_ui` output. Exclusive with query
and coords; may use the latest UI snapshot.

pid.description: Optional process consistency check. It never replaces the exact-window capture receipt.

query.description: Element text or query to click. Exclusive with on and coords; may use the latest UI snapshot.

right.description: Optional. Right-click (secondary click) instead of left-click.

snapshot.description:
Snapshot ID from `see` or `inspect_ui`. Element/query clicks may omit it to use the latest snapshot.
Background coordinate clicks must provide a nonempty ID from a fresh exact-window see.

triple.description: Optional. Triple-click instead of single click.

wait_for.description:
Optional. Maximum milliseconds to re-observe the selected exact window until a query matches.
Default: 5000. Maximum: 60000. A missing snapshot-local on id is reported immediately and is not
remapped onto a later observation. 0 checks the current snapshot once.

name: window
description:
List and manipulate application windows.

Actions:
- list: List windows with IDs, bounds, off-screen state, and combined-observation eligibility
- close: Close a window
- minimize: Minimize a window
- restore: Restore a minimized window without activating or focusing its application
- maximize: Maximize a window
- move: Move a window to specific coordinates (requires x, y)
- resize: Resize a window to specific dimensions (requires width, height)
- set-bounds: Set both position and size (requires x, y, width, height)
- focus: Unavailable under background-only authority; use a human-authorized foreground session or CLI

Background-only close uses Accessibility and fails rather than focusing the app for a global fallback.
A focused/global close fallback is available only to a foreground-capable session with `foreground=true`.

Target windows by application name and optionally by window title or index.
For deterministic targeting, prefer `window_id` (from `peekaboo window list`).
Supports partial title matching for convenience.

JSON Examples (ALWAYS include `action`):
- { "action": "list", "app": "Safari" }
- { "action": "move", "app": "TextEdit", "x": 100, "y": 100 }
- { "action": "restore", "app": "PID:1234", "window_id": 5678 }
- { "action": "set-bounds", "app": "Terminal", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 1280, "height": 720 }
- { "action": "close", "app": "Safari", "title": "Document" }
Peekaboo MCP 4.9.9 using openai/gpt-5.6, anthropic/claude-opus-5

action.description: The background-safe action to perform; focus is unavailable

app.description: Target application name, bundle ID, or process ID

height.description: Height for resize or set-bounds action

include_window_details.description: Details for list results. Defaults to ids, bounds, and off_screen.

title.description: Window title to target (partial matching supported)

width.description: Width for resize or set-bounds action

window_id.description: Window ID (from window list); preferred stable selector

x.description: X coordinate for move or set-bounds action

y.description: Y coordinate for move or set-bounds action

name: dialog

action.description: Background-safe dialog action; file and global input are unavailable

button.description: Button text to click. Use 'default' to click OKButton.

field.description: Field label/placeholder to target (for input action).

field_index.description: Field index (0-based) to target (for input action).

name: menu
description:
Inspect or click application menu items under immutable background-only authority. Available actions are
`list` and `click`; neither activates the application. Click requires an exact app name, bundle ID, or PID,
while read-only list retains fuzzy name matching. Foreground menu expansion is unavailable in this session.

Examples:
- List Chrome menus: { "action": "list", "app": "Google Chrome" }
- Save document: { "action": "click", "app": "TextEdit", "path": "File > Save" }
Peekaboo MCP 4.9.9

action.description: Use 'list' to discover menus or 'click' to interact with menu items.

app.description: Target application name, bundle ID, or process ID. Click and foreground list require an exact selector; background list permits fuzzy names.

item.description: Simple menu item to click (for non-nested items)

path.description: Menu path for nested items (e.g., 'File > Save As...' or 'Edit > Copy')

name: permissions
description:
Check macOS system permissions required for automation.
Verifies Screen Recording and Accessibility as required permissions and reports
Event Synthesizing as an action-specific input limitation when it is unavailable.
Peekaboo MCP 4.9.9 using openai/gpt-5.6, anthropic/claude-opus-5

name: type
description:
Types text into UI elements, a targeted app process, or one exact background window.
Supports human typing (--wpm) or fixed-delay (--delay) pacing. Use `press` for key presses and chords.
Default background-only MCP/Agent delivery requires an explicit fresh exact non-dialog snapshot receipt.
An optional element ID must come from that snapshot. App/PID/window-only, implicit-latest, competing
selector, targetless, and foreground forms are refused before dispatch. Use clear=true with literal text
when replacement is intended and a confirmed typing result is required; other event injection remains
honestly unverifiable and requires fresh observation.
Peekaboo MCP 4.9.9 using openai/gpt-5.6
and anthropic/claude-opus-5

clear.description: Optional. Clear before typing. Clear plus literal text can be confirmed by private non-secure AX value readback; clear=false typing remains unverifiable.

coordinate_reference.description: Optional capture reference from see. When supplied it must equal snapshot.

coordinate_space.description: Coordinate basis for coords. Defaults to global_display_points.

coords.description:
Optional exact-window focus point in x,y form. It is mutually exclusive with on and requires a fresh
screenshot snapshot. Peekaboo performs focus-only Accessibility targeting at this point, never clicks,
presses, or selects the hit element, and types under one exact target lane.

delay.description: Optional. Delay between keystrokes in milliseconds (linear profile). Default: 0.

on.description: Optional element ID from the required explicit snapshot.

profile.description: Optional. Typing profile: linear (default) or human.

snapshot.description: Required fresh exact non-dialog snapshot ID from `see` or `inspect_ui`.

wpm.description: Optional. Human typing speed (80-220 WPM). Overrides delay when set.

name: see
description:
Captures a screenshot of the active UI and generates an element map.

Returns opaque Peekaboo element IDs that can be passed unchanged to interaction commands.
Do not infer an element's role or type from the shape of its ID. Creates or updates a
snapshot that tracks UI state. Observation is background-only and does not focus the target
unless `web_focus` is explicitly enabled for sparse embedded web content.

annotate.description: Optional. Add interaction markers and IDs to the returned screenshot.

app_target.description:
Optional. Specifies the capture target (same as image tool).
For example:
Omit or use an empty string (e.g., '') for all screens.
Use 'screen:INDEX' (e.g., 'screen:0') for a specific display.
Use 'frontmost' for all windows of the current foreground application.
Use 'AppName' (e.g., 'Safari') for all windows of that application.
Use 'PID:PROCESS_ID' (e.g., 'PID:663') to target a specific process by its PID.

capture_engine.description:
Optional. auto (default), modern (ScreenCaptureKit), or classic (no ScreenCaptureKit).
Use classic to recover safely from a ScreenCaptureKit owner refusal.

fresh.description: Optional. Require a fresh, uncached Accessibility tree; refuse if unavailable.

include_elements.description:
Optional. Also return the element table as structured data in `_meta.ui_elements`, using the same fields as
`peekaboo see --json`, together with `_meta.snapshot_id`. Off by default because a window can expose hundreds
of elements.

max_children.description:
Optional. Maximum AX children per node. Env fallback: PEEKABOO_AX_MAX_CHILDREN.
Increase this for flat Qt/Electron panels with many sibling controls.

max_depth.description: Optional. Maximum AX traversal depth. Env fallback: PEEKABOO_AX_MAX_DEPTH.

max_elements.description: Optional. Maximum AX elements to collect. Env fallback: PEEKABOO_AX_MAX_ELEMENTS.

ocr.description:
Optional. Add text recognized locally on the selected host with Apple Vision to the accessibility
element map. OCR text is non-actionable and does not replace accessible controls.

path.description: Optional. Path to save the screenshot. If omitted, a temporary file is used.

roi.description:
Optional. Crop the exact window as x,y,width,height in window-local logical points. Requires
window_id, creates a fresh snapshot, and returns ROI-local element bounds plus a coordinate
context for image_pixels or normalized clicks.

snapshot.description: Optional. Snapshot ID for UI automation tracking. A new snapshot is created when absent.

web_focus.description: Optional. Allow an AXPress retry on sparse Chromium/Tauri web content.

window_id.description:
Optional. Exact CoreGraphics window ID. May be used alone; when app_target names an application
or PID, Peekaboo also verifies owner agreement. Numeric app_target suffixes remain window indexes.
